subject: Lockpoint EDR & MDM — license extension options and pilot playbook
messages:
From: Rachael Brooks <rachael.brooks@lockpoint.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Lockpoint — EDR/MDM license term and extension options

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our conversation I wanted to surface a concise set of options for moving from your expiring bundle into a managed term that preserves telemetry retention and gives you a predictable unit cost. Attached: Lockpoint_Pricing_2026Q2.xlsx and a short SOC2 summary (Lockpoint_SOC2_Summary.pdf).

Quick summary (options):
- 12-month extension (standard): no install work, price lock at current list + 6%.
- 24-month extension: 8% discount, includes priority onboarding and quarterly health checks.
- 36-month commitment: 14% discount + two complimentary vulnerability scans per year.

We can also do a staged pilot for up to 500 endpoints (free, 30 days) to validate telemetry integration and agent stability. If it helps procurement, I can issue a consolidated SOW that lists deliverables, pilot success criteria, and payment milestones.

Next steps we usually see: vendor SOW -> procurement PO -> security pilot -> full deployment. If you share your procurement contact, I can prepare a DocuSign-ready SOW and a consolidated pricing sheet.

Attachments: Lockpoint_Pricing_2026Q2.xlsx (spreadsheet), Lockpoint_SOC2_Summary.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Rachael Brooks

Subject: Re: Lockpoint — EDR/MDM license term and extension options

Rachael — thanks for the options and the SOC2 summary. Marissa, looping you for procurement intake and PO path. Karthik and Grace, looping you for security & ops questions (see below).

A few clarifying items before we push a SOW to legal/finance:
- Can Lockpoint confirm endpoint counts used for pricing are active seats (not endpoint IDs created historically)? We need a clear license metric for BYOD and contractors.
- Telemetry retention: current requirement is 90 days of raw telemetry and 365 days of indexed events for incident hunting. Will Lockpoint meet that out of the box or via an add-on?
- macOS (Apple Silicon) agent: compatibility and CPU/RAM impact for typical developer workloads.
- For the pilot: we prefer 30 days, 300–500 endpoints, and a short acceptance checklist (agent stability, event fidelity, acceptable false-positive rate).

If you can send a draft SOW that includes the pilot scope and a DocuSign link for procurement, we can route. Please mark pricing as quote-protected through the end of next week (6/4) while we evaluate.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of IT Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-30T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Lockpoint — EDR/MDM license term and extension options

James/Rachael — thanks for the SOW and appendix. A few technical clarifications before we sign anything:
1) Vulnerability scanner integration: will Lockpoint push vuln findings to our existing ticketing system (Jira) or do we need a connector? We prefer push to a dedicated project with labels and priority mapping.
2) Agent communication: does the agent use persistent socket to your cloud or is it pull-based? We have strict firewall egress policies; need an allowlist of FQDNs and ports.
3) For telemetry retention you quoted 365 days indexed for 24/36 month tiers — confirm whether that includes full packet captures or only metadata/event indexing.
4) EDR offline behavior: on isolated networks or VMs with no internet, will the agent queue events locally and forward on next check-in?

We will want a 2-week technical pilot with a small SRE cohort (10 endpoints) prior to the 30-day org-wide pilot to validate integration and agent performance. Please detail the testing criteria for CPU impact and false-positive rate thresholds.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Security Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Subject: RE: Lockpoint — EDR/MDM license term and extension options (next steps & pilot)

Team — thanks for the detailed feedback. Finalizing items here so we have a single playbook to hand to procurement and security:

Agreed pilot plan:
- 2-week technical validation (10 SRE endpoints) followed by 30-day org pilot (up to 500 endpoints).
- Acceptance criteria: agent stability (no crashes for 14 days), CPU overhead <3% median, event fidelity >= 95% against baseline test cases, successful Jira integration for vuln findings (webhook + mapping).

License & retention:
- Licensing: active endpoints (30d check-in). Contractors counted if corporate access used.
- Retention: 90 days raw telemetry + 365 days indexed included for 24/36 terms. 12-month term includes 90 days indexed; upgrade available as add-on.

Procurement items:
- I've uploaded a DocuSign SOW (pilot + 12/24/36 pricing) — link: https://app.docusign.com/Lockpoint-SOW-2026
- Attached revised SOW includes firewall/allowlist details, offline queue behavior, and appendix for Apple Silicon benchmarks.
- Pricing hold: quote protected through 2026-06-04.

Next steps (owner / ETA):
- Hannah: confirm pilot cohort by 2026-06-04.
- Marissa: open PR / PO path once GL & payment terms confirmed.
- Karthik: confirm any additional test vectors for the 2-week validation by 2026-06-03.
- James/Rachael: push DocuSign SOW to Marissa once GL confirmed.

Attachments: SOW_Lockpoint_2026-06.pdf, Lockpoint_Pricing_2026Q2.xlsx
